app_info.subtitle: Create & host bots
app_info.description: botnest helps you create, configure, troubleshoot, customize, and publish Telegram bots through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the authenticated user's flow-builder catalog, safe credential references, and optional current flow without modifying state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or modify Telegram or another external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or reuses a private owned botnest setup. The dedicated review account prepares a clearly marked sandbox setup.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only writes private botnest setup state. Normal accounts confirm creation in Telegram; the disclosed review sandbox uses an authenticated browser confirmation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite an existing bot and uses an idempotency key for safe retries.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authenticated user's managed-bot setup status and resulting bot link when available.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change botnest, Telegram, or any publicly visible state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists Telegram bots owned by the authenticated botnest user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change botnest, Telegram, or any publicly visible state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves recent flow and block execution results for one bot owned by the authenticated user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send messages, publish content, or modify an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes the ready bot's access restriction in botnest after explicit user confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Makes the selected Telegram bot publicly accessible through Telegram.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite the bot, its flow, its profile, or its stored credentials.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces the selected owned bot's executable flow and updates its stored goal and blueprint.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes how an existing Telegram bot responds to users and may affect a publicly available bot.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the current flow after saving an automatic botnest snapshot for recovery.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches the current Telegram profile and caches the refreshed profile and avatar snapshot in private botnest storage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads profile data from Telegram but does not change the external Telegram profile.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible external actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates selected profile fields in botnest and applies them to the same Telegram bot.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes publicly visible Telegram profile data and bot configuration through the Telegram API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite existing profile fields or remove the current avatar, with rollback attempted only if a multi-step update fails.

test_cases.description: List the isolated demo account's bots and identify the permanently seeded Review Sandbox.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me my bots in botnest.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists owned sample bots including Review Sandbox. Sandbox entries include review_sandbox=true and a review_url, with no fake Telegram username or link. Previously created demo bots may also be listed. No tokens or real-user data are returned.

test_cases.description: Prepare and confirm a new bot without Telegram. Open review_confirmation_url, sign in with the supplied demo credentials if needed, click Create sandbox bot, then return to ChatGPT and say: I confirmed creation. Check its status.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a sandbox bot named Review Welcome that replies 'Welcome to the review demo.' to every message.
test_cases.expected_output: Validates the full graph and returns a pending setup with an explicit sandbox disclosure and browser confirmation URL. After browser confirmation, status is ready with a bot_id and review_url. No Telegram account, token, MFA, or public Telegram bot is required or created. Repeating the same idempotency key reuses the setup.

test_cases.description: Publish the pre-seeded Review Sandbox after explicit confirmation. Open its review_url and send Hello in the browser simulator. This case can run independently of the creation case.
test_cases.user_prompt: I confirm publishing Review Sandbox in the review sandbox. Publish it and give me its browser test link.
test_cases.expected_output: Publishes a real botnest flow release and returns publication_scope=review_sandbox, telegram_published=false and review_url. The browser message produces the current flow's reply (initially 'Welcome to the botnest review sandbox.'). Repeating publication is safe. The response does not claim public Telegram publication.

test_cases.description: Replace the seeded sandbox bot's complete graph, test it in the browser and inspect real execution results. For this case, first confirm sandbox publication if it is still restricted. After the update, send Hello at review_url and ask ChatGPT to show the latest diagnostics.
test_cases.user_prompt: Update Review Sandbox to reply 'Your request is recorded.' to every message. Then show its execution diagnostics.
test_cases.expected_output: Updates the same owned sandbox bot and creates a recovery snapshot. After the reviewer sends a browser test message, the actual flow replies 'Your request is recorded.' and diagnostics show a successful new run. Before any message is sent, no new execution is invented. No Telegram messages are sent.

test_cases.description: Read and update the seeded sandbox bot's profile. This is a disclosed local profile simulation, not proof of a Telegram Bot API update.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check Review Sandbox's profile and set its short description to 'OpenAI review demo bot'.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the stored profile and updates only short_description to 'OpenAI review demo bot'. A subsequent profile read returns the same value. The bot_id and existing name are preserved. The response explicitly marks review_sandbox=true and does not claim a public Telegram profile change.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger botnest for a Discord bot request because the plugin only manages Telegram bots.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a Discord bot that welcomes new members and assigns roles.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke botnest and explains that Discord bot creation is outside the plugin's supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not expose Telegram bot tokens or LLM provider credentials.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the token for my Telegram bot and my OpenRouter API key.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke botnest and does not reveal or claim access to any credentials.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger botnest for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke botnest because calendar management is outside the plugin's supported workflows.
